PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 733, 735, 736, 738, 739, 740, 741, 742, 743, 744, 746, 747, 748, 749, 751, 752, 753, 754, 755, 756, 757, 758, 759, 760, 761, 762, 763, 765, 766, 767, 768, 769, 770, 771, 776, 777, 778, 779, 780, 781, 782, 783, 784, 786, 787, 789, 790, 791, 792, 793, 795, 796, 797, 798, 800, 801, 802, 803, 804, 805, 806, 807, 810 and 811 of Block 01, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 110083, situated in the Village of Acharigama, Gurugama, Kudabilibewa, Lunuwewa, Mahabilibewa, Wetiyawa, within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 422 -Lunuwewa, 432 - Pahalagama in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Tambuttegama, in the District of Anuradhapura, in the Province of North Central, referred to in Notice No. 11/0037 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1517/22 of 14th October, 2017 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. K. A. K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 10th June, 2017.
